rules.description: Miryoku L1: numbers/symbols — hold left_command
Miryoku L2: navigation — hold space
Miryoku L3: shifted symbols — hold right_command
Miryoku L4: mouse-layer remnant — hold right_option
Miryoku: thumb layer-tap triggers (⌘L→L1 tap⇥, ␣→L2, ⌘R→L3 tap⌫, ⌥R→L4 tap⏎; modifiers not emitted)
Miryoku: combos (S+D→Esc, F+J→CapsLock, D+F→⇧, J+K→⇧)
Caps Lock to Escape on single press, Control on press and hold.
Mouseless: tap Left Command/Option for Meh shortcuts
Right Command number and symbol layer
Change right_command+hjkl to arrow keys
Change right_command+asdfgzxcvb to right_shift+number keys
Browsers: Left Command+J toggles Developer Tools
kitty: cmd+[ to ctrl+l, cmd+shift+[/] to ctrl+opt+p/n
Mouse button 5 to Mission Control
HHKB Fn number row to F1-F10
Emacs-inspired control editing shortcuts

manipulators.description: Pass Meh+F through for Mouseless before Control+F mappings
Pass Meh+M through for Mouseless before Control+M becomes Enter

rules.description: Right Option to left click on single press, Right Option on press and hold.
Right Control to right click on single press, Right Control on press and hold.
Emacs key bindings [control+keys] (rev 11)
Space numpad layer: space+m,.jkluio to keypad 1-9, space+right_command to keypad 0
